items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Well I had played with Stuff Smith's band around (inaudible) '35

ctx.x: And this club was controlled by a bunch of gangsters too. And Charlie Green, the booking agent in New York, say, "Look, you can only stay there for a little while, because I want you to go there, because I'm eventually going to send you to Buffalo."
"I'm thinking on buying Stuff Smath's band." Well I had played with Stuff Smith's band around (inaudible) '35 when they came down from Buffalo. They played at the Lafayette Theater.

And he asked me would I go and do some dates with him in Philly. His piano player was from Philly, so we worked two to three gigs out in Philly, Wilmington, Delaware, and we came back to New York, and
